import Mathlib
example (x : ℝ) : (nhdsWithin x (Set.Iio x)).NeBot := inferInstance
example (x : ℝ) : (nhdsWithin x (Set.Ioi x)).NeBot := inferInstance
example {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Monotone f) (a b : ℝ) :
    eVariationOn f (Set.Icc a b) = ENNReal.ofReal (f b - f a) := by
  rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
  · simpa using (hf.monotoneOn (Set.Icc a b)).eVariationOn_eq (left_mem_Icc.2 hab) (right_mem_Icc.2 hab)
  · rw [Set.Icc_eq_empty hba]
